name: Asterion's Horn Axe
description: A great axe forged from labyrinth bronze and set with the Minotaur's horn. Halvard's finest work this year.
flavor_text: It always swings a little to the left.

name: Dewglass Circlet
description: A circlet of fae dewglass and tide pearls. It sings very quietly when you think clearly.
flavor_text: The fae never lie. Neither does this.

name: Hydrascale Mail
description: Mail of overlapping hydra scales on a heartstone frame. Scratches in it close by morning.
flavor_text: Cut it once, it grows back twice.

name: Mirrorsteel Blade
description: A sword of star metal polished with haunted mirror glass. Your reflection in it is always a beat ahead.
flavor_text: It shows you where the blow will land.

name: Stormcaller Staff
description: A staff of thunderbird feathers bound around a storm capacitor. Your hair stands on end when you hold it.
flavor_text: Point it at the sky only if you mean it.

name: Rimeward Cloak
description: A cloak lined with everfrost and stitched with ectoplasm thread. Cold never reaches you, and neither do ghosts.

name: Clockwork Gauntlets
description: Brass gauntlets with a golem core in each palm. Your grip ticks.
flavor_text: Odo says they're perfectly safe. Odo has nine fingers.

name: Seraph-Feather Mantle
description: A mantle of seraph feathers sewn to bell-bronze links, blessed by Brother Cassian. Light pools around you.

name: Wyrmscale Bulwark
description: Armour of black dragon scale, quenched in phoenix fire. Halvard says it's the best thing he has ever made, and he is a dwarf.

name: Dreamthread Ring
description: A ring spun from dream ichor, set with a chronoshard and a bead of void. Wear it to sleep and you will remember tomorrow.
flavor_text: Lady Vos wanted it for her cabinet. She let you keep it. Mostly.
